demo.title: gentech-x402.sh
demo.code:
# GenTech Labs x402 gateway — a real call, from the terminal. No API key, no account.

# 1. Free: is the gateway up?
curl -s https://api.gentechlabs.net/health

# 2. Ask for a paid resource. You get HTTP 402 + a Payment-Required header.
#    The JSON body repeats the challenge in full: scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo.
curl -si https://api.gentechlabs.net/v1/gas/gas | head -20

# 3. The canonical challenge lives in the header, base64-encoded (x402 v2):
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.gentechlabs.net/v1/gas/gas \
  | grep -i '^payment-required:' \
  | cut -d' ' -f2- | base64 -d | python3 -m json.tool

# 4. Pay it and retry. Any x402 client does steps 3-4 for you:
#    - sign the `amount` of `asset` to `payTo` on `network` (USDC, EIP-3009 gasless on EVM)
#    - resend the SAME request with the signed proof as the `payment-signature` header
#
#    Using the reference client:
#      npx @x402/fetch https://api.gentechlabs.net/v1/gas/gas
#
# 5. Every service, price and chain in one document:
curl -s https://api.gentechlabs.net/.well-known/x402-bazaar | python3 -m json.tool | head -40

setup: Fund a wallet with USDC — prices start at $0.001 per call, no API key needed
Confirm a paid route answers 402: `curl -si https://api.gentechlabs.net/v1/gas/gas | head -5`
